projects.name: AI and Cloud Transformation
details: Aiden AI | Client: Aon (Benefits & Claims Vertical)
• Led end-to-end delivery of AI, automation, and cloud transformation programs, managing project lifecycles from
initiation through production deployment using Agile and Scrum methodologies.
• Managed multiple AI -driven initiatives supporting Aon's Benefits and Claims business units, ensuring alignment
with business objectives, compliance requirements, and operational priorities.
• Defined project roadmaps, sprint plans, milestones, release schedules, and delivery metrics to ensure predictable
execution and stakeholder transparency.
• Coordinated cross -functional teams consisting of AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Cloud Architects, QA teams,
Business Analysts, and Product Owners to deliver scalable enterprise solutions.
• Facilitated Agile ceremonies including daily stand -ups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and
retrospectives to improve delivery velocity and team effectiveness.
• Directed cloud migration and deployment activities from Microsoft Azure to Amazon Web Services (AWS), ensuring
minimal business disruption and successful production cutovers.
• Partnered with business stakeholders and client leadership to gather requirements, prioritize features, manage
scope, and drive strategic decision-making.
• Monitored project risks, dependencies, and resource allocation while implementing mitigation plans to maintain
schedule and budget objectives.
• Managed AI solution delivery pipelines, coordinating development, testing, deployment, and post -production
support activities.
• Enabled adoption of agentic AI workflows, intelligent automation frameworks, and prompt-engineering practices
to improve productivity and operational efficiency.
• Utilized JIRA for project planning, documentation, sprint tracking, and knowledge management.
• Drove continuous process improvement initiatives, reducing delivery bottlenecks and enhancing project
governance across multiple workstreams.
